phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Repo structure, config system, logging, and a bootable CLI that prints system state.

acceptance_criteria.text: synkage/<layer>/__init__.py exists for all 10 layers
pip install -r requirements.txt succeeds on Python 3.10+
load_config validates all five config files; invalid config raises ConfigError naming the file
python scripts/run_synkage.py exits 0 and prints autonomy default, risk classes, never-autonomous list, tools
Bad --config-dir exits 1 with an error on stderr
Logging level honours --log-level and SYNKAGE_LOG_LEVEL
acceptance_criteria.evidence: run_synkage.py --log-level DEBUG version → 'DEBUG Loaded config from …/config' on stderr; same with SYNKAGE_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG

acceptance_criteria.text: config/schema/tool_registry.schema.json is committed and matches the pydantic model
ruff check, ruff format --check, OKF lint (0 errors) and phases_status.py all pass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ruff: All checks passed; okf_lint: 0 errors; phases_status: exit 0

phases.title: Brain layer
phases.goal: Commands parse into structured intents and the autonomy guard decides when confirmation is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: 'send message to Rahul' parses to Intent(verb=send, object=message, target=Rahul) — unit test passes
'use gmail' resolves to tool id gmail via command_aliases.yaml; 'dry run' / 'preview only' / 'ask before send' / 'auto execute' set the intent's autonomy modifier — unit tests pass
A command with unclear tool or target yields mode=preview (never execute) — unit test passes
autonomy_guard returns requires_confirmation=True for every never_autonomous category and for high/critical risk at every level — parametrised test passes
Confirmation loop shows plan + tool target and proceeds only on explicit 'yes' — test with scripted input covers yes/no/empty
Interactive CLI loop (prompt-toolkit) reads a command and prints the parsed intent and required autonomy — CliRunner/scripted-input test passes

phases.title: Agent layer
phases.goal: Prime delegates a task to a specialist agent that returns a file artifact.

acceptance_criteria.text: base_agent defines a typed task contract (input, output artifact path, status) — unit test passes
planner, builder, reporter agents each produce an artifact file from a sample task — one test per agent
Chain planner → builder → reporter passes artifacts through files only — integration test passes
Prime.delegate(intent) picks an agent and returns its artifact path — test passes

phases.title: Skills system
phases.goal: Agents invoke stateless, permission-gated skills through a registry.

acceptance_criteria.text: Skill registry lists registered skills and rejects duplicates — test passes
Calling a skill the agent lacks permission for raises PermissionDenied — test passes
At least 3 of the 5 MVP skills implemented, each with a passing unit test
An agent from Phase 2 invokes a skill only via the registry — test passes

phases.title: Execution routing
phases.goal: An intent routes through the autonomy router to an adapter and returns a normalised result.

acceptance_criteria.text: tool_adapter_base defines execute() → ExecutionResult; local_exec and openclaw stub implement it — tests pass
Router picks the adapter named by the tool's registry entry — test passes
Router refuses to execute an unconfirmed high/critical or never_autonomous action — test passes
Every execution appends an audit record with intent, tool, autonomy level, confirmation state, result — test reads it back
'dry run' produces a plan and result without calling the adapter — test passes

phases.title: Tool control
phases.goal: Synkage drafts a message in a real app and saves a native note, with confirmation before send.

acceptance_criteria.text: Browser controller launches Chromium via Playwright and opens a URL — test against a local page passes
WhatsApp Web flow fills a draft and stops at the confirmation prompt; nothing is sent without 'yes' — test with a mock page passes, plus one manual run recorded
Gmail flow creates a draft (not sent) — mock-page test passes, plus one manual run recorded
'save this as a note' writes a note via the desktop adapter — test passes on the target OS
Matching tool entries set enabled: true in tool_registry.json and the status table shows them enabled

phases.title: Situation awareness
phases.goal: Autonomy thresholds change with detected situation state.

acceptance_criteria.text: situation_detector maps fixture signal sets to each of the 5 states — parametrised test passes
Same intent gets a different confirmation requirement in Focused vs Idle — test passes
Never-autonomous and high/critical still require confirmation in every state — test passes
CLI status shows the current situation state

phases.title: Memory & night cycle
phases.goal: State persists across runs and a nightly job updates trust.

acceptance_criteria.text: Memory files are created on first run at the chosen location and survive restart — test passes
night_cycle compresses logs older than N days into a summary — test passes
night_cycle changes the trust score from logged outcomes — test passes
scripts/nightly_update.py runs the cycle once and exits 0; apscheduler job registered — test passes

phases.title: OpenClaw integration (optional)
phases.goal: Synkage delegates execution to OpenClaw safely.

acceptance_criteria.text: openclaw_adapter implements tool_adapter_base against the real OpenClaw API — integration test passes
An OpenClaw action mapped to high risk still triggers confirmation — test passes
OpenClaw results pass through the brain verifier — test passes

phases.title: Avatar layer (locked)
phases.goal: Avatar reflects system state without controlling logic.

acceptance_criteria.text: state_mapper emits avatar state for each system state — test passes
Websocket bridge streams state to a client — integration test passes
Avatar has no code path into brain/execution — import-boundary test passes
